note: GROUNDWORK PLATFORM DEFAULT — applies to every tenant/company on the CRM unless a tenant overrides it via /finance/config. The CRM role strings on the left (admin, office_manager, estimator, etc., found in src/index.tsx's requireAuth-gated routes) are defined by the shared Groundwork CRM application code itself, not per-tenant — every company using this CRM has the same role vocabulary. The Finance-OS-role values on the right (crew | crew_lead | office | owner, docs/spec/ROLES.md) are this build's inferred, conservative default policy for how those roles translate to financial visibility — not confirmed by any real customer, including whichever company happens to be the CRM's first tenant. CLAUDE.md only defines crew's restrictions directly. A tenant that wants a different policy sets its own override at /finance/config; editing this file changes the platform-wide starting point for every tenant.
rep_mapping_decision: Reviewed 2026-08-06 against Avalon's real reps table distribution (avalon-sales-hub-production): laborer x4, foreman x4, admin x2, rep x1, office_manager x1 — estimator/field_supervisor/mechanic/view_only have zero real holders, left as-is. rep->crew is now a CONFIRMED decision, not a placeholder guess: src/ui/roles.ts's RolePermissions is binary in practice (crew and crew_lead both see zero financial fields; office and owner both see everything), so the only alternative to crew is a full jump to office-level visibility (margin, wage, rate, receipt management) for a customer-facing sales role with no established bookkeeping need. One person is affected; under-granting costs a follow-up /finance/config edit with no code change, over-granting exposes real wage data to a quoting role. Restrictive-by-default was already this file's stated policy for ambiguous roles — this confirms it with real usage data rather than changing it.
